g.text: Every prediction market looks like a Bloomberg terminal
Pitch in one line: buy Yes or No, right pays $1
Board and market screens, price as a probability
Markets generated from the news on a schedule
Inject today's date; validate every close date
Bugs hidden by RLS returning nothing?
Measure every colour against its surface; four failed, fixed
Live at stips.bet; the job now is getting people to try it
